git.source_scope: private Bilinc Enterprise foundation; no Cloud source mutation

dataset.split: repository foundation verification; no customer data

runner.protocol: disposable Modal Linux container; repository source copied without .git, dependencies, build output or secret-like files; backend, web, traceability and policy checks run in a clean image
commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ruff check src tests

environment.hardware: 8 requested CPU, 16 GiB requested memory; container reported 24 CPUs
environment.modal_cost_basis: metered Modal billing report after completion

limitations: This is a Modal foundation verification, not a full Docker/PostgreSQL/customer-data appliance acceptance run.
npm install used an image-only lockfile workaround because the remote environment could not resolve optional npm lock entries; no repository lockfile was changed.
The core-extraction checker exited successfully but reported decision_record_validated=false; owner approval remains a separate gate.
This does not establish SELLABLE_RC, commercial release, offline HSM signature, OCI/Trivy or owner-signing completion.
disallowed_claims: Do not call this Enterprise commercially released or SELLABLE_RC.
Do not treat the foundation verification as a full production appliance acceptance.
Do not infer public Bilinc Cloud deployment or customer-data readiness from this private-repository test.
